objective: Create one production-ready Living Memory loop: photo, real voice, remembering help from Muse, storyteller-owned context, durable completion, playback, optional bounded family share.

gates.G0_BASELINE: Clean install, compile/typecheck, build, existing critical preservation tests.
gates.G1_SOURCE_PRESERVATION: Photo and voice durable, immutable, recoverable, and never falsely reported saved.
gates.G2_MUSE_NO_INVENTION: Real transcription works; Muse helps remembering without judging or inventing; storyteller may edit, approximate, omit, or say unknown.
gates.G3_DURABLE_COMPLETION: Finalize is idempotent; completed Living Memory reopens; original voice plays; activation emits once.
gates.G4_PRIVACY_BOUNDARY: Share Artifact is allowlist-only; failed/revoked sharing cannot expose private archive material.
gates.G5_FULL_JOURNEY_RC: Staging full journey passes on current Android Chrome and iPhone Safari, including rollback evidence.

tasks.deliverable: Freeze transcript, Muse, story-context, completion, activation, share, and failure contracts. Legacy truth-state fields are compatibility-only.
Verify isolated staging D1/R2/AI/Queue configuration and list only genuine blockers.
Queue/STT adapter compiling behind frozen transcript contract.
One-question remembering companion and storyteller-context contract. No credibility, truth, reliability, or dispute labels.
Review/finalization UI shell against contract-valid fixtures.
Allowlist-only bounded Share Artifact contract and preview model.
Idempotent queued transcription, persistence, retries, provider-failure state, and language metadata.
Muse listens to storyteller material, asks one useful remembering question, and offers optional context without inventing or judging.
Redacted English and Spanish/mixed staging evidence plus no-invention fixtures with missing/ambiguous context.
Idempotent finalization, completion moment, reopen, and original-audio playback beside the photograph.
Emit first_living_memory_completed exactly once at durable completion.
Preview plus bounded family link/native handoff; failure leaves the Living Memory private and intact.
One coherent release candidate with interrupted upload, re-login, duplicate queue/finalize, AI failure, and share failure handled.
Full English and Spanish/mixed staging journeys on Android Chrome and iPhone Safari, one unreliable-network pass, rollback evidence.
At least three uncoached people create, replay, and understand optional sharing and the difference between their story and Muse assistance.
Exact RC SHA, clean worktree, green crucial gates, current receipts/runbook, and honest known limitations.

stop_rule: When G5 passes and human proof has no severe trust/comprehension defect, stop feature work and lock the release candidate.
